author: SickProdigy
description: Monitor Garry's Mod servers with safe A2S queries and publish official Steam announcements.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server public GMod connection settings, bounded cached status data, announcement settings, and Steam announcement IDs. It does not store member data or RCON credentials.
install_msg: Add a server with `[p]gmodset add <name> <host> [query-port]`. Configure optional status transitions with `[p]gmodset statuschannel`, and ARK-style official Steam posts with `[p]gmodset updateschannel` followed by `[p]gmodset updates start`. Private/LAN destinations require explicit bot-owner approval.
short: GMod server status and official update announcements
